title: Expose planning list and show CLI
description: Implement wtp planning list and show. List accepts at most one --status plus issue-id, project, milestone, version, feature-id, and feature filters in any flag order, combines grouping filters with AND semantics, and rejects duplicates or empty values. Show accepts one UUID or short ID and no execution agent option. JSON returns stable planning view objects; human list stays compact while show renders every populated metadata field, dependencies, comments already present in the record, and ordered live reusable items. Add empty, filtered, mixed-case, unset, scoped-ID, malformed argument, and deterministic rendering tests.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop

Added compact list output, detailed deterministic show output for populated metadata/dependencies/comments/live reusable assignments, stable JSON handling, help usage, and focused coverage for empty/filtered/mixed-case/unset/scoped/malformed/deterministic cases. Verification passed: go test ./internal/cli -count=1; go test ./... -count=1; go test -race ./internal/cli ./internal/provider/flatfile -count=1; go vet ./...; git diff --check (pre-existing scripts/e2e_smoke.ps1 CRLF warning only).
